The mechanism it relies on is stated from the code rather than assumed: excerpt_of centres on body.lower().find(find.lower()) (scripts/fetch_relay.py:132), which returns the FIRST occurrence in the whole tag-stripped document, so a literal that occurs ONLY in a table header will return the header, while a literal that also occurs in navigation chrome will return the chrome and is useless.
